## Executive summary

Explain what the user can do after this change, why it matters and which issue it completes. Include a small before/after example when useful.

## Scope and definition of done

- Starting branch/commit:
- Agreed files and acceptance criteria:
- Evidence that those criteria are met:
- Anything left for a separate task:

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Fixtures and screenshots contain fictional data only.
- [ ] Any copied code has an identified owner and reuse permission.
- [ ] No credentials, private records, service connections or deployment steps were added.

Report actual command results and any checks you could not run. A checkbox alone is not a test result.

For UI changes, attach 1440px, 768px and 390px screenshots and report keyboard/disclosure behavior, horizontal overflow and console errors.

## Assumptions and remaining questions

Name any unresolved evidence or scope choice. Do not paste private records or credentials.

Adam reviews and decides whether to merge. Agents stop at this review-ready PR unless he explicitly authorizes merging it. A community merge does not deploy the live site.
